paragraphs: I'm applying for the Security Analyst role on SpaceX's Blue Team in Hawthorne. Defending the systems that build and fly Falcon, Dragon and Starlink is the kind of work I want to start my career on, and the Blue Team's mix of threat hunting, investigation and response is where I want to grow. I finished my B.S. in Computer Science at UC Irvine, specializing in Networked Systems, and I'm local to Irvine/Orange County.

Most of my hands-on security work is on CommunicAI, an AI-powered iOS app I built and still operate on the App Store, backed by Google Cloud. I own its security end to end. I wrote role-based access-control rules that block IDOR, privilege escalation and message spoofing, and 36 adversarial unit tests try to break them. My server-side Cloud Functions enforce authentication, input validation and rate limiting, and verify Apple receipts to detect and block subscription fraud. Thinking like an attacker against my own app is the habit I'd bring to hunting threats in yours.

In coursework and labs I've used Wireshark to capture and analyze network traffic and Burp Suite to study attacker techniques like MITM, ARP poisoning, DNS spoofing, SQL injection and XSS. I script in Python and Node.js. I haven't worked a SIEM or a live incident yet, and I'm closing that gap now: I'm studying for the CompTIA Security+ exam in January. As captain of UC Irvine's NCAA Division I track and field team, I'm used to staying calm under pressure and communicating clearly.
I'd welcome the chance to help the Blue Team find and stop threats, and I'm available to start in Summer 2027.
